description: Requires the account session, current X-Organization-Id and CSRF for writes. Read up to 50 private incidents with notice delivery. Send the last event number as before for the next page. A first observed risk is an initial incident, not evidence of an external change. The first DNS and certificate-issuance snapshots are silent baselines. DNS changes, incompatible server samples and connection failures need two distinct observations. Expected IP rotation is silent. Repeated observations do not duplicate a notice. Contact changes expose field states only. Issuance does not prove installation. DNS records do not prove authentication of sent mail.
